newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-SMALL CLAIMS HE WAS GOUGED IN EYE.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SMALL CLAIMS HE WAS GOUGED IN EYE.

text.p: Western Province wing James Small has claimed he was gouged in the eye by his British Lions counterpart John Bentley on Saturday.
Bentley scored two of the Lions' four tries in their 38-21 win.
"What he did was not within the rules of the game," Small said, according to newspaper reports.
"He fingered me in the eye when I defenceless. I thought the act was a cowardly one which is why I didn't shake his hand afterwards."
Lions manager Fran Cotton rejected the allegations on Monday.
"It's not really worthy of comment," he said.
"As far as we are concerned the allegation is nonsense and was motivated by an attempt to deflect attention away from the fact that Small had an average game and Betley put two tries past him."
